content:
Ari: FYI ACME's AE pushed: can we waive the VPC/on-prem platform fee for their evaluation? They said 3w, then 90d. Also asking for an enterprise SLA during eval. Thoughts?
Diego: Waive full fee is heavy. Ops will still need KMS + install prep. Suggest reduced fee or conditional waiver tied to commit.
Maya: DealDesk policy reminder: full platform fee waivers over $75k need SVP sign-off. For small POCs (<$50k) SalesOps can approve credits up to 30%. Need the cost math.
Ari: Customer numbers: approx 2 dedicated GPUs, rough run-rate $10k/GPU/mo so ~$20k/mo. Platform fee on rate card = $20,000 one-time. They want it set to $0 for POC.
Diego: From infra: if we agree, require limited support (business hours only) and explicit POC acceptance criteria. Also need to lock model config (quant profile, KV cache retention) before spin.
Paul: Legal: any concession must be conditional. Proposed conditions: completed security questionnaire, written POC acceptance tests, prohibition on production data, and a minimum conversion or committed term if we waive fee. I'll draft amendment language.
Ari: Commercial compromise idea: waive $20k platform fee in exchange for a 9-month minimum committed spend of $10k/mo (i.e., $90k commit). Offer temporary discount for first 3 months (50% off compute) and Business Hours support during POC. If they convert earlier, adjust.
Maya: Finance check: $90k committed ARR (or commit) vs deferred revenue covers the waived fee; Finance comfortable if signed by month-end. Need CAF (commit approval form) via DealDesk.
Diego: We'll also need region reservation (EU), and a short infra SOW: install window, KMS endpoints, support contact, rollback plan. I'll open infra ticket.
InfraBot: ticket created INC-6001 for on-prem POC prep (:gear:)
Paul: Add legal clause: waiver is revocable if they breach terms (e.g., production data or failure to sign conversion). Also require completion of security questionnaire before deployment.
Ari: Action items:
- Ari: confirm 3w vs 90d with customer and if they accept commit trade
- Diego: produce 1-page SOW + limited support amendment
- Paul: draft conditional waiver & conversion clause
- Maya/DealDesk: route CAF + expedited review if AE pushes for waiver
DealDeskBot: please queue for expedited review if all artifacts attached (SOW, sec questionnaire, CAF).
Ari: I'll push updated proposal into the internal tracker: https://redwood.internal/sales/proposals/1918765432 and ping DealDesk. Will report back when customer confirms eval length.
Diego: One more technical note: if they request 24x7 SLA we must escalate pricing and staff; business-hours triage is the only feasible eval support unless they pay premium.
Maya: Agreed. Keep support tier = Silver (business hours) for POC. If they insist on 24x7 during eval, attach an uplift to the platform fee.
Ari: OK will present the conditional waiver + 9mo commit trade to ACME and update thread. Short replies after this. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
